newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Alcan standout in ADR slump.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Alcan standout in ADR slump.

text.p: Canada's Alcan Aluminium Ltd stood out among foreign stocks on Thursday as most American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) followed the rest of the New York markets downward.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average was down almost 70 points at mid-morning on data showing stronger-than-expected manufacturing activity in December.
"I don't see anything specifically that stands out (among foreign stocks). It's the Dow selling off right now with the European markets weaker across the board," a trader said.
Alcan rose 1/2 to 34-1/8 after Prudential Securities raised its rating for the company to buy from hold. Volume was heavy at 571,000 shares, among the leaders for ADRs.

Israel's Gilat Satellite Networks Ltd rose 1-7/8 to 26-1/2 after the company said it had bought Skydata Inc in a stock swap. Gilat said it expected fourth quarter charges totaling $6 million from the merger and restructuring.
China's Jilin Chemical Industrial Co Ltd rose 1-3/4 to 16-3/8 after it was launched among a Hong Kong basket of call warrants.
Chile's Compania de Telecomunicaciones fell 77-1/4 to 23-7/8 as the company changed the ratio of shares per ADR to four to one from 17 to one.
"They reduced the ratio to improve liquidity," one trader said.
Decliners led advancers by a margin of 280 to 134 among 807 ADRs. Volume was 17.4 million shares in late morning.
